description_expanded: Villa Rosa - 30A Vacation Rental with Private Pool and Golf Cart Favorite Features: - Private Pool - Near Beach - Outdoor Dining - Golf Cart More about Villa Rosa: Discover your perfect beach retreat on 30A: this 5-bedroom, 6.5 bath coastal home features three bunk nooks, a private pool (with optional pool heat during cooler months), and is just a short stroll from the sand. Walk to the vibrant heart of Gulf Place and enjoy boutique shops, cafés, and lively dining. You’re also within easy walking distance of the beloved Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, where gulf views, live music and fresh seafood await. With all the comforts of home, this spacious vacation rental offers the perfect blend of serene private living and walkable beach-town energy.
